Earl Dervish (Japanese: ジョバンニ Giovanni) is the teacher of Earl's Pokémon Academy (known as simply Pokémon School in ), located in Violet City in , , HeartGold, and SoulSilver, and in White City in Pokémon Stadium 2.

==In the games==

===Sprites===
 

==In animation==
 
===History===
Earl appeared in the episode A Bout With Sprout, where he, like in the , was revealed to host his own Pokémon Academy in Violet City. When and entered the school, Earl danced around while wearing a tutu, much to the embarrassment of the group. However, upon learning that Miss Priscilla loved dancing people, joined in and wore a tutu as well.

Later, Earl jumped in the way of Brock's flirting with Miss Priscilla, offering him a chance to stay at the academy, but Brock declined the offer. As Ash and his friends left the Pokémon Academy, Earl, Miss Priscilla, and the academy students waved goodbye to them together.

===Voice actors===
 
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
In Pokémon Adventures, Earl was delivering a package when a robber and his came by and stole it. reluctantly saved Earl as he battled the robber's Donphan with his Aipom when the robber ruined his rice ball. Seeing what Gold did, Earl decided to reward him with a huge stack of rice cakes and then tells him that he had an academy named "Earl Dervish's Pokémon Academy".

Later, he arrived at the academy which was in very poor shape and low on money. He became pleased about the fact that was there to help him, especially when she fed a Berry to a . He explained his story about the school's history to Crystal and then does his twirl. When some came by, Earl got the students away from them and were told to go to the basement. When Crystal left after catching the trouble-making Slugma, Earl informed the students about her departure.

Earl reappeared along with his students in a form of a cameo when a crisis related with and was happening in Ilex Forest. He reappeared in a flashback in the where was explaining his arrival at the Pokémon Academy around the same time the Slugma were attacking and Crystal capturing them.

====Pokémon====
 

===Pokémon Pocket Monsters===
 
Earl appeared in Demanding Tests at the Pokémon School!. When the students recommended to go to the Pokémon academy, Earl greeted him and his Pokémon when they were about to go in. He then explained some of the basics and motivated Red in going. Red agrees to go to the school and Earl teaches a class, with Red as one of his students. He gave out a test. After the test, Earl called down Red to see him after class since he and his Pokémon failed.

Earl was revealed to have imprisoned some Pokémon and then went down a hallway to another room. In the room, Earl shows Red to one of his bright students who ends up battling him. After the battle, Earl and the student was shocked to see that flunking student defeated someone smart. Earl and the student decided that due to Clefairy's skills, he should teach a class. However, this turned out to be false when the students that Clefairy was teaching were giving him a hard time.

====Pokémon====
 

 

==Trivia==
Earl is notable for changing the order of the words in his sentences, somewhat like from , although his grammar is generally incorrect. For example, when asking a potential student if they want to learn from him, he will ask, "What you want to know? Want to be a winner is you?" This may be a reference to the used in the NES game Pro Wrestling, where the phrase "A WINNER IS YOU" is shown at the end of a winning match. Earl does not talk like this in , which may be due to the quite extensive scope of the Pokémon academy in this game.
In the version of Pokémon Gold, Silver, and Crystal, Earl is portrayed with a French accent on top of his incorrect grammar. This is dropped in the German version of Pokémon Stadium 2, similar to the case in the English translation.
In the translation of Pokémon Adventures, Earl is also portrayed with a accent and incorrect grammar.
Earl shares his Japanese name with Giovanni.
